'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Russo-Ukrainian war (2022–present)|Russo-Ukrainian war]]
**[[2025 Sumy offensive]], [[Russian attacks on civilians in the Russo-Ukrainian war]]
***Two people are killed and two others injured by a [[Russian Armed Forces|Russian]] [[guided bomb]] strike on a shop in [[Velyka Pysarivka]], [[Sumy Oblast]], [[Ukraine]]. [https://www.pravda.com.ua/eng/news/2025/12/11/8011403/ (''Ukrainska Pravda'')]
*[[2025 Cambodia‒Thailand conflict]]
**The death toll during the clashes between the [[Royal Thai Army|Thai Army]] and the [[Royal Cambodian Army|Cambodian Army]] at the border increases to eight Thai soldiers, eleven [[Cambodia]]n civilians and four [[Thailand|Thai]] civilians. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2025/12/11/cross-border-fighting-between-thailand-cambodia-enters-fourth-day (Al Jazeera)]
*[[Nigerian bandit conflict]]
**Eleven bandits are killed and several more injured in an ambush by the [[Nigerian Army]] in [[Sabon Birni]], [[Sokoto State]], [[Nigeria]]. The bandits allegedly planned an attack on a nearby village. [https://guardian.ng/news/nigeria/metro/army-neutralises-11-bandits-recovers-weapons-in-sokoto/ (''The Guardian'')]

'''Arts and culture'''
*[[The Game Awards 2025]]
**''[[Clair Obscur: Expedition 33]]'' receives thirteen nominations and nine wins, the most in the show's history, including [[The Game Award for Game of the Year|Game of the Year]]. [https://www.npr.org/2025/12/12/nx-s1-5640839/game-awards-2025-winners-clair-obscur-expedition-33 (NPR)]

'''Business and economy'''
*[[Greece|Greek]] [[Ministry of National Economy and Finance (Greece)|economic minister]] [[Kyriakos Pierrakakis]] is elected the new president of the [[Eurogroup]], succeeding [[Paschal Donohoe]]. [https://www.reuters.com/business/finance/greek-finance-minister-pierrakakis-named-new-head-eurogroup-2025-12-11/ (Reuters)]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*Two people are killed and two others are trapped when an under-construction [[library]] collapses in [[Gwangju]], [[South Korea]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/asia-pacific/two-missing-after-collapse-south-korea-library-construction-site-2025-12-11/ (Reuters)]
*One person is killed and several others are injured when a boat carrying migrants overturns on the [[Sava]] river near [[Slavonski Brod]], [[Croatia]]. [https://apnews.com/article/croatia-migrants-boat-overturns-sava-slavonski-brod-7fcca54e774bdc5191510d1bd911cb75 (AP)]

'''Law and crime'''
*[[Hijab and burqa controversies in Europe]]
**[[Austria]] passes a [[Law of Austria|law]] banning [[hijab]]s and [[burqa]]s being worn in schools by girls aged under 14.  [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/cn4djk0jj4xo (BBC News)]
*[[Brazil]]ian [[Federal Police of Brazil|police]] arrest former [[Peru]]vian [[Ministry of Foreign Affairs (Peru)|foreign minister]] [[:es:Augusto Blacker Miller|Augusto Blacker Miller]] in [[Rio de Janeiro]], where he is located after evading authorities following an [[Albania]]n [[Judiciary of Albania|court]] conviction for fraud and an active [[Interpol notice]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/americas/former-peruvian-foreign-minister-arrested-brazil-sources-say-2025-12-12/ (Reuters)]
*A [[Court-martial|military court]] in [[Pakistan]] sentences former [[Inter-Services Intelligence]] director general [[Faiz Hameed]] to 14 years in prison on charges related to engaging in political activities and violations of the [[Official Secrets Act (Pakistan)|Official Secrets Act]]. [https://apnews.com/article/pakistan-military-court-former-spy-chief-sentenced-75de95fabba1a7147dbdb33bce8ba41d (AP)]

'''Politics and elections'''
*[[2025 Bulgarian budget protests]]
**The [[Zhelyazkov Government]] resigns after weeks of massive protests against economic policies and alleged corruption. [https://www.theguardian.com/world/2025/dec/11/bulgarian-government-resigns-mass-anti-corruption-protests (''The Guardian'')]
*[[2025 Falkland Islands general election]]
**[[Falkland Islanders|Falklanders]] vote to elect eight members of the [[Legislative Assembly of the Falkland Islands|Legislative Assembly]]. [https://fitv.co.fk/news-and-events/falkland-islands-general-election-2025-election-night-updates/ (Falkland Islands TV)]
*{{ill|2025 Portuguese general strike|pt|Greve geral portuguesa de 2025}}
**The [[General Confederation of the Portuguese Workers]] and the [[General Union of Workers (Portugal)|General Union of Workers]], which together represent nearly 1 million workers in [[Portugal]], launch a [[general strike]] across the country to protest against [[XXV Constitutional Government of Portugal|the government]]'s planned changes to [[labour laws]]. [https://apnews.com/article/portugal-strike-unions-government-employment-law-7ab975372784b5ff81075569efac8e33 (AP)]
*[[2025–2026 United States redistricting]]
**The [[Indiana Senate]] rejects a [[2025 Indiana redistricting attempt|proposal]] backed by [[President of the United States|U.S. President]] [[Donald Trump]] that would redraw the [[Indiana's congressional districts|congressional districts]] in the [[U.S. state]] of [[Indiana]] in a 31-19 vote, with 21 [[Indiana Republican Party|state]] [[Republican Party (United States)|Republicans]] joining all 10 [[Indiana Democratic Party|Democrats]] in voting against the proposal. [https://www.reuters.com/world/us/indiana-senate-rejects-trump-backed-congressional-redistricting-2025-12-11/ (Reuters)] [https://www.nbcnews.com/politics/elections/indiana-senate-vote-trump-backed-congressional-map-gop-resistance-rcna247833 (NBC News)]
  
'''Sports'''
*[[Match fixing in tennis]]
**The [[International Tennis Integrity Agency]] fines [[French Tennis Federation|French]] player [[Quentin Folliot]] US$70,000 and suspends him from play for 20 years for alleged [[match-fixing]]. He is the sixth player to be fined in a wider investigation involving other French and [[Italian Tennis and Padel Federation|Italian]] players. [https://apnews.com/article/quentin-folliot-suspension-matchfixing-6cc175a789658bd0e4887355c2e332db (AP)]
